# Municipal Ordinance No. 001, Series of 2003

**Municipal Ordinance No. 001**

## Summary

A resolution creating the position of Local Legislative Staff Employee II in the Office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], Quezon, in order to carry out the needs of the Sangguniang Bayan office. The creation of the position is deemed necessary for proper staffing, more efficient and effective delivery of basic services to the constituents, and to realign the title of the position with the scope of work and corresponding salary. The position is created with salary grade 4 in the plantilla of personnel schedule. The motion was made by Hon. [[Benedicto T. Lao]] and seconded by Hon. [[Vidal L. Glinoga Jr.]], and was unanimously approved.

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1.** The position of Local Legislative Staff Employee II is hereby created in the office of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon with salary grade 4 in the plantilla of personnel schedule.
- **Section 2.** Function, Duties and Responsibilities:
  1. File and record all pertinent documents such as Approved Resolutions and Ordinances of the [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
  2. File all important communication coming from different agencies of the government
  3. Assist in making Resolutions and Ordinances
- **Section 3.** The corresponding appropriation for the said position shall be included in the Annual Budget CY 2003.
- **Section 4.** This ordinance shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
- **Section 5.** Approved by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon this 6th day of January, 2003.
